document.benchmarkDefinition: 64 fresh input-only cases balanced by stage bucket, steam and PAcount; all methods use these same64. Historical gen2 old64 benchmark stays a separate cached reference.

candidatePoolOrthogonalArray.strataConvention: half-open bins, with the exact endpoint 1 in the final bin

document.freshSubsetMethod: Exactly four per stage count2..64, two per steam state. Deterministic hash stage ordering; sequential input-only score favors distinct PA and draw counts within each stage, then global PA/side/pair balance, then SHA priority. No solver outcome or label is used.
document.primaryComparison: Fresh252 never-before-solved operating inputs. Old395 geometry-test inputs were previously reported and are regression evidence, not a newly blind test. Recovery256 is outcome-conditioned diagnostic evidence. All candidate selection uses original405 validation only.
document.recoveryDefinition: Original2046 failed cases minus147 native-accepted gen2 rescues leaves1899 matrix failures; add35 prior failures. Six advisory-only rescues are not called failures or used as fitted labels.
document.trainingPolicy: Exactly96 strictly qualified TRAIN rescues may augment483 original qualified training labels.26 validation and19 test rescues never fit. Original folds are immutable. Fresh pool and selected holdouts never fit.

document.selectionRule: Maximize strict-qualified native validation solves among declared new candidates; ties use smaller artifact then lexical id. Select a neural model and a transfer model independently; no fresh-test outcomes are consulted.
document.runtimePolicy: Expose selected Gen3 neural model as an explicit experimental family; preserve Gen2 and local-expert default. Profile transfer remains an offline comparison candidate.

document.retention: Outside build/ so gradle clean does not delete this cache. Never used as an output directory.
document.scope: Canonical teacher/design, both trained candidates, validation/evaluation/benchmark results, provenance and model. Duplicate model-directory copies of cases.jsonl are represented by study/v2/cases.jsonl.

run.memoryScope: No process-memory claim for assembled reference outcomes.
run.qualificationScope: Fresh252 and original matrix references use CURRENT_ONLY. Historical prior failures retain their original protocol, including five wet-continuation failures; those five are not relabelled CURRENT_ONLY.
run.timingScope: No new877-case solver run. Cached physical outcomes only; mixed-run timing was intentionally omitted.

evidence.memoryInterpretation: Working set/private bytes and JVM heap are whole-process measures. Per-thread allocated bytes are cumulative allocation volume, not retained RAM. Separate pool peaks are not summed.

run.memoryScope: thread allocated bytes are allocation volume, not retained RAM; heap/RSS values are whole-process measurements

comparisonPolicy: Only original validation selects candidates. Fresh252 is the primary new operating holdout; old395 is previously reported geometry-test replay. Recovery samples are outcome-conditioned; fitted-rescue replay is explicitly not generalization.

fullRecoveryUnionDiagnostic.scope: Separate diagnostic on full remaining-gen2-failure runs only. One input contributes once to the union, even if both methods solve it. The predeclared256 recovery sample is not added or pooled. This is outcome-conditioned recovery, not prospective population accuracy.

junit.scope: Relevant V3 initializer, physical-acceptance, concurrent admission and UI/codec regression tests; not the entire repository suite.

verification.nativeQualification: All experiment corrections used existing physical audits and final Newton certificates. No thermodynamic equation, convergence tolerance, or native solver implementation was changed.

excludedMeasurementTrials.reason: Interrupted after detecting the memory sampler had selected the Gradle launcher. Partial outcomes and wrong-process memory are excluded from every reported comparison. Repeated with an explicit solver main-class match.

data.fittingPolicy: Only original train-fold qualified labels, including 96 recovered train cases. The 26 validation and 19 test recoveries remain in their original folds and never enter fitting.

gen3-mlp.architecture: global branch classifier + branch-conditioned shared two-hidden-layer stage MLP
gen3-mlp.component_treatment: All fractions variable; identical per-component target transformation
gen3-mlp.normalization_fitted_on: training columns only, equal total weight per column
gen3-mlp.selection_on: whole validation columns; no tray-level split
gen3-mlp.bounds_source: predeclared matrix input domain, without outcomes

gen3-factorized.architecture: shared stage MLP with separately weighted phase-total heads, feed-prior softmax compositions, and optional conservative seed-support logits
gen3-factorized.normalization_fitted_on: training columns only, equal total weight per column

nearest-k1.normalizationFittedOn: qualified TRAIN reference inputs only; all component fractions receive equal weights
nearest-k1.coverageBoundsFrom: all frozen authored DOE inputs only; optional predeclared physical design pressure envelope; no outcomes
nearest-k1.distanceCalibration: 1.5 times largest leave-one-input-out TRAIN nearest distance, floored at0.5
declines: incompatible basis/formulation or outside authored bounds
no same-steam reference (also identical PA/draw counts by default)
requested rectifying section absent in source
nearest-k1.transfer: feed-anchored piecewise interpolation with rectifying clamp; component-specific feed-ratio scaling; same branch and mapped wet mask only
nearest-k1.evaluationRequirement: Native requested-column correction and unchanged physical acceptance; reference retrieval itself is not convergence

gen2CacheVerification.scope: Original study data, weights, folds, validation/evaluation/serial/profile results and provenance; outside build so Gradle clean preserves this cache.

document.cycleAvoidance: Final model card, final case map, and this manifest are outside study.zip; the final card may reference the resulting manifest hash
document.entryPathConvention: POSIX paths relative to build/neural-gen3; extract study.zip directly into that directory
excluded: analysis/* other than the four final summary files
document.restoreOmittedDuplicates: Optionally copy data/cases.jsonl to mlp-v1/cases.jsonl after extraction; those duplicate bytes are stored only once
document.retention: Outside build/ so Gradle clean does not delete the archive. Existing changed or incomplete cache revisions are never overwritten
document.verification: SHA-256 and byte count for every streamed source, complete journal line counts, every decompressed entry round-tripped through SHA-256/CRC, compressed archive SHA-256, then every live source rechecked

deployment.scope: Optional TJL20 initialization guess for the existing property package and declared geometry/operating bounds. Raw predictions are never published as converged solutions.

archivedCaseMap.scope: Every new candidate input, every original training-design input and all historical retry inputs; frozen cohort memberships and exact listed Gen3 observations with per-run reference provenance. An absent observation means no execution under that listed Gen3 run label, not that the older teacher never ran the input. Full profiles and original teacher outcomes remain in journals/the immutable Gen2 cache, identified by hashes in this card.
